steps.title: Apply to the UGC
steps.detail: Apply online at ugc.ac.lk, then send the signed printout with your documents by registered post so it reaches the UGC before the closing date.
steps.when: Closing date: set by the UGC press notice
steps.quote: The last date for the receipt of applications for admission will be specified in the press notice referred to above.

steps.title: Change your Uni-Code order (once)
steps.detail: You may change, add or remove Uni-Codes online only once, then post the signed new order. Check your list's order in FindMyWay before you do.
steps.when: Within 2 weeks of the application closing date
steps.quote: Candidates are permitted to change their order of “Uni Codes” online within two (02) weeks of the closing date of applications

steps.title: Apply for the aptitude test
steps.detail: Courses on your list with a practical or aptitude test need a separate application to that university.
steps.when: Set by each university's press notice
steps.quote: the students should apply directly to the respective universities in order to face the practical/ aptitude tests

steps.title: Selection results
steps.detail: The UGC tells each selected student their course and university.
steps.quote: The successful candidates will be informed of their course of study and the university to which they have been selected by the UGC.

steps.title: Register for your course
steps.detail: If you accept the offer, pay the Rs. 50 registration fee and register online before the UGC's last date.
steps.when: Last date: given by the UGC with your selection
steps.quote: should make the payment of Rs. 50/= as the registration fee to the bank or online in credit of the University Grants Commission and register online via the official website of UGC for the selected course of study of the university on or before the last date given for registration by the UGC.

notices.title: Inspector of Customs, Grade II: open competitive exam

age.quote: is not less than 18 years and not more than 24 years of age to the closing date of applications

al.quote: Should have passed three main subjects at the GCE (A/L) examination in one sitting

notices.ol: Six O/L passes with five credits, including Sinhala or Tamil and Mathematics, and at least a pass in English
notices.provider: Department of Sri Lanka Customs (exam by Department of Examinations)
notices.sourceLocator: Gazette 11.09.2026 Part I Sec (IIA), pp.3208-3212, notice 09-99

notices.title: National Diploma in Technology, University of Moratuwa

age.quote: Applicants should be below 24 years of age on 31.12.2025

al.quote: Applicants should have obtained passes for following three (03) subjects: (i) Physics (ii) Chemistry (iii) Combined Mathematics or Higher Mathematics at one and the same sitting

notices.ol: Marine Engineering Technology and Nautical Studies also need a credit (C) in English at O/L
notices.provider: Institute of Technology, University of Moratuwa (ITUM)
notices.sourceLocator: Gazette No. 2507 of 18.09.2026, Part I Sec (IIA), pp.3253-3256, notice 'Admission to the National Diploma in Technology Course - 2026/2027'; closing confirmed on itum.mrt.ac.lk/ndt-26_27-intake

age.quote: Candidates must be between 16 and 35 years of age as of 31.12.2026

notices.ol: Six O/L passes including Sinhala, Science and Mathematics (with a credit in Mathematics or Science), or two A/L passes including Science or a technology subject with the O/L passes
notices.provider: National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority (NAITA) - Industrial Engineering Training Institute (IETI), Moratuwa
notices.sourceLocator: Gazette 18.09.2026 Part I Sec (IIA), pp.3256-3260, NAITA notice 'IETI - Moratuwa recruiting apprentices for full-time courses - January 2027 batch'

notices.title: ICT Technician apprenticeship, NAITA IETI Moratuwa

age.quote: Candidates must be between 16 and 35 years of age as of 31.12.2026

notices.ol: Six O/L passes including Sinhala and Mathematics, a pass in English (O/L or A/L) and a basic computer course
notices.provider: National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority (NAITA) - Industrial Engineering Training Institute (IETI), Moratuwa

notices.title: Management Service Officers, Grade III: open competitive exam

age.quote: Shall be not less than 18 years and not more than 30 years of age as at the closing date of applications

al.quote: Shall have passed all the subjects in General Certificate of Education (Advanced Level) at one sitting

notices.ol: Six O/L passes with four credits, including a language and Mathematics, at one sitting
notices.provider: Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government (Director General of Combined Services); exam by Department of Examinations
notices.sourceLocator: Gazette 28.08.2026 Part I Sec (IIA), pp.2993-2994+, 'Open Competitive Examination for Recruitment to Grade III of Management Service Officers Service - 2026'
